name: valueOfAdventure
description: What is a marginal barf turn worth to you?

name: garbo_vipClan
description: What is your vip clan? Set to current clan if you don't have access to one (And then get whitelisted to BAFH. It's free!).

name: garbo_stashClan
description: What is your stash clan? Set to 'none' to disable borrowing shared equipment from a clan stash.

name: garbo_skipAscensionCheck
description: Should skip verifying that your account has broken the prism? Set to true if you want to proceed regardless, and false if you'd like to be warned.

name: garbo_valueOfFreeFight
description: What is a free fightun worth to you? (Default 2000).

name: garbo_fightGlitch
description: Should we fight the glitch season reward? This assumes you have access to many skills--Curse of Marinara, Conspiratorial Whispers, Shadow Noodles, and more.

name: garbo_buyPass
description: Should a dinsey day pass be bought with FunFunds (if possible) at the end of the script?

name: garbo_yachtzeechain
description: only diets after free fights, and attempts to estimate if Yachtzee! chaining is profitable for you. Requires Spring Break Beach access (it will not grab a one-day pass for you, but will make an attempt if one is used).

name: garbo_skipPillCheck
description: Should skip prompting you to go acquire distention and synthetic dog hair pills? Set to true if you want to proceed without them, and false if you want to be reminded.

name: garbo_prioritizeCappingGuzzlr
description: Should garbo prioritize capping your Guzzlr tablet over getting guzzlrbucks?

name: garbo_autoUserConfirm
description: **WARNING: Experimental** Don't show user confirm dialogs, instead automatically select yes/no in a way that will allow garbo to continue executing. Useful for scripting/headless. Risky and potentially destructive.

name: garbo_autoUserConfirm_targetInvocationsThreshold
description: This is used only when autoUserConfirm is true, will automatically use resources (such as pocket wishes, 11-leaf clovers, etc) up to this threshold to source a target monster for chaining before requesting user interference.

name: garbo_IgnoreMarginalFamiliars
description: Should garbo use only your meat familiar throughout your barf-turns, or should it also use drops familiars to maximize profit?

name: garbo_restoreHpTarget
description: If you're a very high level, what HP threshold should garbo aim to maintain?

name: garbo_bczStatFloor
description: When greater than zero, Garbo will not allow Blood Cubic Zirconia usage to push your stats below this number. (IE, if you pick 200, Garbo will never use enough BCZ casts to get your base Moxie stat below 200.)

name: garbo_pearls
description: Which unblemished pearls should garbo farm before barf turns? A comma-separated, ordered list of spooky, sleaze, hot, stench, cold, or all. Leave empty to farm none. Each zone is farmed only when its expected profit beats the turns it costs at valueOfAdventure. Run "garbo pearlreport" to see the estimate without spending anything.

name: garbo_pearlRequireCap
description: Should pearl farming halt instead of farming a zone whose elemental resistance is below the 18-resistance progress cap?

name: garbo_pearlForce
description: Should garbo farm the selected pearl zones even when the profit model expects them to lose meat?

name: garbo_pearlAirMode
description: How should pearl farming get underwater breathing when no air effect is active? effects: spend the 1/day air consumables first and equip gear only as a fallback. gear: never spend consumables. auto: spend consumables only when the freed gear slot buys a resistance progress tier.

name: garbo_pearlPotionPrice
description: Most meat to pay per resistance potion while pearl farming. 0 never buys; owned potions are still used when the turns they save pay for them.

name: garbo_pearlLuckyFishy
description: Should pearl farming refresh Fishy with Lucky! and The Haggling? This spends the same Lucky! sources (saxophone, Heartstone, August scepter, clovers, pill keeper) garbo uses for its own lucky adventures, and the profit model prices the free ones at 0.

name: garbo_pearlCloverPrice
description: Most meat to pay per mall 11-leaf clover for the pearl Fishy refresh. 0 never buys.

name: garbo_pearlMomBuff
description: Spend Mom Sea Monkee's free daily food on a pearl zone that cannot reach the resistance cap? true picks the first such zone; an element (spooky, sleaze, hot, stench, cold) reserves it for that zone. Leave empty to never visit Mom.

name: garbo_pearlCodpiece
description: Should garbo socket unblemished pearls into The Eternity Codpiece after pearl farming? Other gems are evicted back to inventory. Wear the codpiece at rollover for the bonus adventures.

name: garbo_pearlDrunkWeapon
description: Which weapon should pearl farming wield while overdrunk with Drunkula's wineglass?

name: garbo_pearlLeeroyJenkins
description: Overdrunk pearl farming only: should garbo fight on when the weapon cannot guarantee a one-shot of the zone's toughest monster, instead of skipping the zone?

name: garbo_pearlOvercapped
description: Should pearl farming wear every owned organ extender, not only the ones needed to adventure?

name: garbo_pearlFishMaxxing
description: Should pearl farming turn every pearl-zone monster into some fish with the Monodent of the Sea, banking Fishy from the Book of Facts? Needs a class and path whose fact for some fish is Fishy.
